name: Default
shortDescription: Standalone Milvus vector database with etcd metadata, MinIO object storage and authentication enabled.

alerts.message: Authentication is enabled. Connect as user root with the generated MILVUS_ROOT_PASSWORD and rotate it from a client if needed; changing the variable after the first start has no effect. The domain serves the RESTful API only; gRPC SDK clients connect from apps in the same environment at milvus:19530.
